_comment: The platform-tokens.json table as the test expects it. A new row or string fails the test until this file is edited in the same change, which a reviewer sees.

entries.why: The Web Push SSRF allowlist. The browser picks the push service, not the user, so the allowlist cannot be a setting without weakening the guard.
